note: RUBRIC_SLIM_SPEC batch: old U5 L4-6 (bias of estimators, sampling distribution of p-hat and of a difference; NEW Unit 3). CB sampling-distribution FRQs score: center and spread computed with work, the condition check (Large Counts) for shape, the z / probability with work, and the conclusion tied to that probability. 'Typically varies by about ... from ...' is the scored SD interpretation. Applied with scripts/rubric-slim-apply.mjs. Revised after the Codex review of new U3/U4 (DO NOT SHIP -> fixed): a full inference procedure requires the ids that compose College Board's four compound points (hypotheses incl. parameter, procedure + every condition, mechanics with work, decision + justification in context) even when that is 6-8 ids; explicitly requested interpretations and reasons restored; E/P/I made uniform and disjoint (all / all-but-one / two-or-more).
